title: Inter: Carlos Augusto to 2031? Gazzetta says 15 days | Nerazzurri Daily No. 52
description:
Carlos Augusto is not Inter's backup any more - and the papers say a deal to 2031 is weeks away.
Free daily newsletter: https://www.nerazzurridaily.com/go/yt/?ed=52

Blue means the club said it. Pink means only the papers did.

CONFIRMED - Inter 1-0 Shakhtar Donetsk, Carlos Augusto 77', Bastoni sent off 68' (Champions League, matchday 3, Oct 21).
CONFIRMED - Fiorentina come to San Siro 18th with the league's worst defense, 17 goals conceded (Inter.it, Oct 22).
REPORTED - The extension to 2031 should be defined inside fifteen days, pay rising from EUR 2.2M to EUR 3.5M plus bonuses (Gazzetta dello Sport via FCInterNews, Oct 23).
REPORTED - Corriere dello Sport is less definite and gives the club about a month (Corriere dello Sport via FCInterNews, Oct 23).
REPORTED - Ivan Provedel is set for his first Inter start, 235 days after shoulder surgery (Tuttosport via FCInterNews, Oct 23).

Next up: Fiorentina at San Siro, Sunday, October 25 - 7:30 AM ET / 12:30 in Milan / CBSSN, Telemundo, Paramount+.
